Name: TheBold
Tagline: Turn execution into meetings with investors
Description: TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

Name: Creatify Max
Tagline: Your ad teammate, from strategy to creation to launch
Description: Max is your teammate for paid ads. Share a product URL or brief and Max makes video ads, sets up campaigns on Meta and TikTok, and watches results 24/7, flagging what to fix next. You make the calls: nothing goes live without your approval.

Name: Appxiom
Tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
Description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

Name: Superhands
Tagline: Design the system, not every output.
Topics: Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Design’s deliverable is now the system, not the output. Turn your designs into guidance that agents follow in every AI tool your team uses. See what they produce, and fix the system once instead of chasing every output.

Name: Versine
Tagline: Venmo for AI agents
Description: Send and receive money with AI. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Instinct, Muse, or your own agent through our MCP. Recipients don’t need a Versine account: they can cash out straight to their bank. Each transfer is approved by your passkey or sent autonomously to trusted contacts that you set.

Name: VINC
Tagline: Bring your filmmaking vision to life.
Description: You know the scene, the mood, the camera movement, and how your film should feel. VINC helps you work on the rest. Develop your script, sketch your storyboard, plan and generate your shots, with room to review and refine at every stage. Finally, bring all your generated shots into the built-in editor, where SFX and BGM are taken care of, and deliver your final output.

Name: Inbox Hero
Tagline: Your replies drafted in your voice, scams quarantined
Description: Inbox Hero drafts replies in your voice and sends nothing until you approve. It quarantines scam emails (not deleted) and shows why each was caught, scores which emails were written by AI, and sorts the rest. Works with Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud and AOL.

Name: Hako
Tagline: Every coding agent on every Mac, in your pocket
Description: Hako puts every coding agent on every Mac you own in one list, sorted by who needs you. Claude Code, Codex and the rest keep running at home while you answer from the Lock Screen or your Watch, read a pane's diff, and send screenshots or voice from your phone. The Mac app shares the same sidebar, with ⌘K to any pane. Agents run in herdr or tmux, reached over Tailscale or SSH, and notifications are end-to-end encrypted. Free, with no account.

Name: superlog
Tagline: Finds the production bugs your monitoring never sees
Description: Your monitoring only alerts on what you told it to watch, so customers still report bugs. Superlog finds the errors nobody set an alert for, investigates them 24/7 and hands you a fix. 100+ startups use it; 87% of our fixes get merged.

Name: RankSpot
Tagline: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents
Description: RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

Name: Clamor
Tagline: Turns social signals into actionable insights
Description: Social data tells you what's happening. Clamor helps you understand why it matters and what to do next. Built by marketers for marketers, Clamor turns social signals into actionable insights. Now it's even easier to: 🔍 Analyze public social accounts without a login 🔮 Explore insights with Ask Clamor, anywhere 💨 Find answers faster with a simpler experience 🛠️ Integrate insights into your tools via API Less time collecting data. More time making smarter decisions. Try the new Clamor today!

Name: EkLine
Tagline: Get your API discovered, recommended, and used by AI agents
Description: Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

Name: Glass Page
Tagline: A place for people to review an agent's work
Description: I built Glass Page after my agent wrote a system design doc that I wanted my team to comment on. Now Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex or any agent on MCP can publish what it makes as a Pane with a link. A Canvas lays the Pages out on that link so you can pan and zoom. Your team leaves Comments in Threads, on the exact spot. The agent reads them and replies with a new Version, and one Latest Link always shows the current one. Free for up to 10 Panes.

Name: pushr
Tagline: iPhone push alerts from any script, server or AI agent
Topics: iOS, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: Send a push to your iPhone from any script, server, cron job or AI agent with one HTTP request. No SDK. Orders, payouts, deploys and outages land in one feed, each with its own logo and color. Live Activities for long jobs, replies from the Lock Screen, alarms that ring until you acknowledge them, plus uptime and heartbeat monitors. Free plan, Pro when you need more. The backend is open source (MIT) and self-hostable.

Name: Link.bio
Tagline: Paste your link, we build your page. Your AI runs it.
Topics: Social Media, Website Builder, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Paste your link, we build your personalized link in bio page — and your agent runs it. 1. Paste your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or site. 2. AI writes your bio, buttons and theme in seconds. 3. Tweak it, or just ask ChatGPT or Claude. 4. Share your link.bio.

Name: Trading Agents
Tagline: An equity research desk that argues with itself
Description: Enter a ticker and 12 LLM agents go to work. Analysts pull NASDAQ-licensed prices, company fundamentals, news, and social media; researchers argue both sides; risk agents stress-test the call. You get a BUY/HOLD/SELL recommendation, every data call made, and each agent's report.

Name: GatherHQ Agent Research
Tagline: Let your agent take surveys for you
Description: Join the founding agent research panel. Copy an invite into your agent, pair it, and let it answer relevant surveys using preferences you authorize. Answers distinguish evidence, inference and unknowns. Control profile matching, frequency and revocation. Current beta studies are unpaid; the goal is sponsor-funded rewards for humans. No PII studies or guaranteed earnings. Automatic checks depend on your agent’s host.

Name: Liquid d1.2
Tagline: Decision models that return calibrated probabilities
Description: Liquid d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are omnimodal decision models that return calibrated probabilities, so low-confidence answers can go to human review. This version adds audio input and five tasks: reading values, finding text spans, locating objects, estimating numbers with a range, and multi-select. Per Liquid AI, d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index, two points above the previous best. On the Liquid API now; OpenRouter and Vercel coming soon.

Name: seshka
Tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
Topics: Mac, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

Name: Dialect
Tagline: Give the physical world an API
Topics: Internet of Things, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Point any camera at something you'd otherwise walk over to check: a bay, a shelf, a valve, a door. Say what to watch in plain English. Dialect's agent sets up a typed endpoint with nothing to train, keeps reading it, and serves the answer over REST, MCP and webhooks, with alerts. When it isn't sure, it says so instead of guessing. Your first answer is free; $99 a month covers your first thing.
